Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the comparative criteria in the final step. The task asked which director was born *earlier* (i.e., has the smaller birth year). The data gathered showed Eduardo Morera was born in 1906 and Jos Luis Garci was born in 1944. Since 1906 is earlier than 1944, Morera was born earlier. However, the Planner concluded that "Solos en la madrugada" (directed by Garci) had the director born earlier, stating "Jos Luis Garci (born 1944) is older at release than Eduardo Morera (born 1906), so Solos en la madrugada is the film whose director was born earlier." This logic is flawed: being "older at release" or having a later birth year does not mean one was born *earlier* in time. The Planner confused the concept of "born earlier" (chronologically first) with "older age" or "later birth year," leading to the wrong final answer.
